description: Sample target patterns used to prove the pipeline. They are NOT the customer's approved architecture; replace with the customer's reference patterns before relying on any recommendation.

host_configuration.title: Harden host configuration to the approved baseline
host_configuration.target_pattern: Hosts conform to the approved hardening baseline with drift detection
host_configuration.action: Bring the affected hosts' configuration in line with the approved baseline, starting with the settings named in the findings
alternatives: Compensating control: restrict administrative access paths until the baseline can be applied
Rebuild from a hardened image instead of in-place change
prerequisites: Approved baseline version for this OS
owner_questions: Which team owns the baseline for this platform?
validation_steps: Re-run the same assessment after the change and compare the observation
Confirm the setting through the platform's own configuration view
host_configuration.rollback: Restore the previous configuration from the recorded backup or configuration management history
host_configuration.acceptance_test: The previously failing check reports the expected value in a fresh assessment
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

identity_configuration.title: Enforce the identity and credential policy
identity_configuration.target_pattern: Credential and authentication settings follow the approved identity policy
identity_configuration.action: Align the affected systems' credential settings with the approved identity policy
alternatives: Delegate authentication to the central identity provider
Apply the policy through group policy or equivalent central control
prerequisites: Identity policy approved by the policy owner
owner_questions: Is a central identity provider available for these systems?
validation_steps: Re-run the assessment after the change
Verify with the identity team that the policy is applied centrally
identity_configuration.rollback: Revert the setting to its previous value through the same configuration channel
identity_configuration.acceptance_test: The credential setting meets the policy value in a fresh assessment
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

logging.title: Enable the required audit logging
logging.target_pattern: Security-relevant events are logged and forwarded to central monitoring
logging.action: Enable audit logging on the affected hosts and confirm events reach the central log store
alternatives: Forward existing local logs while full logging is planned
prerequisites: Central log store capacity and retention agreed
owner_questions: Who monitors the central log store?
validation_steps: Confirm test events appear in the central store
Re-run the assessment
logging.rollback: Disable the added logging categories if they impact performance, keeping the minimum required set
logging.acceptance_test: Audit logging reports enabled in a fresh assessment and events are visible centrally
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

vulnerability.title: Remediate reported vulnerabilities in priority order
vulnerability.target_pattern: Known vulnerabilities are remediated within the approved timeframes
vulnerability.action: Plan remediation of the reported critical and high vulnerabilities on the affected assets, starting with the highest-risk asset
alternatives: Virtual patching or access restriction while the fix is scheduled
Replace the affected component if no fix exists
prerequisites: Maintenance window agreed with the service owner
owner_questions: Is the vendor fix compatible with the installed application stack?
What is the support status of the affected software? (not assumed here)
validation_steps: Re-scan the same scope with the same feed after the change
Confirm the fixed version through the package inventory
vulnerability.rollback: Roll back to the previous package or snapshot per the change procedure
vulnerability.acceptance_test: The vulnerability no longer appears in a fresh scan of the same scope
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

network_exposure.title: Reduce exposure of legacy remote-access services
network_exposure.target_pattern: Remote-access services are restricted to approved management networks and use encrypted protocols
network_exposure.action: Restrict or retire the exposed legacy remote-access services identified in the findings
alternatives: Place the service behind a bastion or VPN
Replace the service with an encrypted equivalent
prerequisites: Inventory of who still uses the service
owner_questions: Is the service still required, and by whom?
validation_steps: Re-run the bounded port assessment and compare open ports
Confirm with the network team that the rule change is in effect
network_exposure.rollback: Re-enable the previous access rule through the firewall change process
network_exposure.acceptance_test: The legacy ports are no longer open in a fresh assessment from the same vantage point
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

cloud_posture.title: Correct cloud resource configuration
cloud_posture.target_pattern: Cloud resources follow the approved secure configuration baseline
cloud_posture.action: Correct the cloud resource settings named in the findings, starting with publicly exposed storage
alternatives: Add a preventive guardrail so the setting cannot regress
Restrict access with a resource policy while the full fix is planned
prerequisites: Least-privilege role to make the change
owner_questions: Does any workload depend on the current access setting?
validation_steps: Re-run the cloud posture assessment for the same account and region
Review the change in the cloud audit trail
cloud_posture.rollback: Restore the prior resource policy from version history or infrastructure-as-code
cloud_posture.acceptance_test: The check passes in a fresh assessment of the same account and region
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

web_security.title: Address reported web application weaknesses
web_security.target_pattern: Web applications set the approved security headers and controls
web_security.action: Review the reported web alerts with the application owner and schedule the fixes by risk
alternatives: Add the missing controls at the reverse proxy or gateway
Accept and document risk where a fix is not feasible
owner_questions: Which team can change the application or its gateway?
validation_steps: Re-run the passive baseline against the same site
Verify the response headers directly
web_security.rollback: Revert the gateway or application configuration to the previous release
web_security.acceptance_test: The alerts no longer appear in a fresh baseline of the same site
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

transport_security.title: Correct transport security configuration
transport_security.target_pattern: Public endpoints use currently supported TLS with valid, verifiable certificates
transport_security.action: Fix the certificate or protocol issues reported for the endpoint
alternatives: Terminate TLS at a managed load balancer
owner_questions: Who owns the certificate lifecycle for this endpoint?
validation_steps: Re-run the passive URL smoke test
Check the chain with an independent TLS client
transport_security.rollback: Reinstall the previous certificate and configuration
transport_security.acceptance_test: TLS verification succeeds with an acceptable remaining validity in a fresh smoke test
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

http_headers.title: Set the approved HTTP security headers
http_headers.target_pattern: Responses carry the approved security headers
http_headers.action: Add the missing security headers at the application or gateway
alternatives: Set headers centrally at the reverse proxy
owner_questions: Where are response headers managed for this service?
validation_steps: Re-run the passive URL smoke test
Inspect the response headers
http_headers.rollback: Remove the added header if it breaks a client
http_headers.acceptance_test: The headers are present in a fresh smoke test
assumptions: Compatibility with dependent services has not been verified
Change windows and ownership must be confirmed by the asset owner

asset_governance.title: Complete asset ownership and criticality records
asset_governance.target_pattern: Every asset has a named owner, a criticality and a recent inventory record
asset_governance.action: Have the inventory owner supply owner, criticality and a fresh record for the listed assets
alternatives: Run a discovery reconciliation against the cloud and endpoint inventories
owner_questions: Who is accountable for the inventory source?
validation_steps: Re-import the inventory and compare
Confirm owners acknowledge their assets
asset_governance.rollback: Not applicable: records can be corrected again at any time
asset_governance.acceptance_test: The listed assets show owner, criticality and a recent record after a fresh import
assumptions: Ownership and criticality must come from the owner, never inferred
